findings.issue: Blanket catch{} in all four detail resolvers (also move.resolver.ts:43, ability.resolver.ts:36, type.resolver.ts:52) renders API 500s, network failures and internal TypeErrors as 'Not found' with HTTP 404, masking outages and bugs
findings.suggestion: Distinguish 404 from other failures (check the HttpErrorResponse status) and let unexpected errors propagate to withNavigationErrorHandler; at minimum log the original error

findings.issue: No unit tests at all despite the vitest unit-test builder being configured in angular.json:47 and jsdom/vitest installed
findings.suggestion: Add Vitest specs for the pure logic: util.ts helpers, PokedexData.cardsFor (alt-form exclusion, species mapping), and the move-table building/sort order

findings.issue: homeResolver and typesResolver have no error handling; an API failure cancels navigation leaving the previous/blank view, and no withNavigationErrorHandler is configured in app.config.ts
findings.suggestion: Register withNavigationErrorHandler (e.g. redirect to an error state) or give these routes the same catch-and-degrade treatment as the detail resolvers

findings.issue: Every keystroke in the search box triggers router.navigate, pushing one browser history entry per character
findings.suggestion: Pass replaceUrl: true for search-as-you-type (keep push for filter/pagination changes) or debounce navigation

findings.issue: API base URL runtime config relies on a window.__API_BASE_URL__ global set by a render-blocking /config.js script, instead of the documented provideAppInitializer + assets/config.json pattern
findings.suggestion: Use provideAppInitializer to fetch config before bootstrap, or at least make the script defer/async — the current contract is fragile and undocumented outside code comments

findings.issue: allowedHosts: ['*'] disables Angular's host-header validation, relying on the (assumed) upstream proxy
findings.suggestion: Make the allowed host list configurable via env var with a safe default, keeping validation on in the common case

findings.issue: Doc comment claims 'in-memory per-session cache' but the @Service() is a process-lifetime root singleton; the comment misleads about scope
findings.suggestion: Fix the comment to describe actual scope (per-render on server, per-app in browser) and note the growth characteristics

findings.issue: @angular/forms is listed as a dependency but no module imports it (grep of src/ finds nothing)
All ~600 lines of CSS live in one global stylesheet with generic class names (.card, .facts, .cards, .result-count) consumed by many components, inviting collisions as the app grows
findings.suggestion: Move per-component rules into component styleUrl files or prefix shared classes (pokedex-card, pokedex-facts)

findings.issue: Search-box sync uses an effect with a manual lastRequestedSearch guard to echo-protect against URL round-trips
findings.suggestion: Model searchText as linkedSignal({source: q input}) or split URL state from input state to remove the guard bookkeeping

summary: A genuinely idiomatic, well-layered Angular 22 app: resolvers + component input binding for SSR data loading, signal-based state, modern naming, and careful 404/hydration handling. The main review objections are that blanket catches mask server errors and bugs as 404s, the home route has no failure path, and there are zero unit tests despite a fully wired vitest setup. I'd merge after one round addressing error handling and adding tests for the pure logic.
